starterPackage.name: Starter
deliverables: 5-page website (Home, About, Services, Contact, optional Blog/Portfolio)
Mobile-responsive, clean design from HDS token system
Google Business Profile cleanup and optimization
Brand audit deck — current touchpoints + 3 easy wins
starterPackage.pitch: Get online and look professional. Everything someone needs to find you, trust you, and contact you.

growthPackage.name: Growth
deliverables: Lead capture form + automated email acknowledgment
Basic reporting dashboard (weekly lead count, form submissions)
Inbox triage setup (if they have email overload)
growthPackage.pitch: A website that works while you sleep — leads captured, followed up, and tracked without you lifting a finger.

consultQuestions: What do you have today — website, social, nothing?
What's the main thing you want someone to do when they find you online?
Do you have a logo, brand colors, or anything you've built brand-wise?
Is there a competitor or another business whose website you really like?
What's your timeline — is there a deadline driving this?
How do leads or customers find you today?
What's your biggest frustration with how things work right now?
Are you open to automation that handles repetitive admin — or is it just the website?

prepChecklist.item: Review Drive recording and extract company/contact/industry
Prepare 1-page Hirobius intro (who we are, who we work with)
Prepare Starter vs Growth comparison slide
Send calendar invite for first formal consult
